to_confirm: Staff names, roles and emails (who gets new leads)
Services customers book and how long each takes
Price list: every product/service and its price (the AI only quotes approved prices)
GST registration and rate (needed before any quote or invoice)
Payment terms (days) and how long a quote stays valid
Which accounting software they use (e.g. Xero)
Their WhatsApp Business number and Meta business verification (for the live system)

problems.solution: Bookings in one calendar per person, and every customer gets a reminder a day before
Every enquiry gets an owner, a next step and a reminder; nothing waits without someone responsible

problems.problem: Quotations take time and are not followed up
problems.solution: Quotations from the price list in one tap, and an automatic follow-up when the customer goes quiet

problems.problem: Everything is written by hand in different places
problems.solution: One system for customers, jobs, quotations and invoices

problems.problem: Replying to every WhatsApp message takes the owner's time
problems.solution: The AI assistant answers in seconds, day and night, and books the job

problems.problem: Invoices and payments are tracked by hand
problems.solution: Invoices from accepted quotations, and payments tracked until paid

problems.problem: The owner cannot see what is happening
problems.solution: A morning report with the numbers that matter

agents.name: Sparkle Home Cleaning Assistant
agents.purpose: Answer customers on WhatsApp day and night: understand the problem (what is wrong, how many units, the address), offer free service visits and book them, and prepare quotations from the price list.
agents.persona: warm, short and professional, like a helpful front-desk person; Singapore customers
rules: Put the customer's address and job details in the booking notes.
Ask one question at a time.

automations.name: Call new enquiries that went quiet

actions.title: Call {first_name}: no reply since the first message

actions.instruction: Politely check whether the customer has questions about quotation {quote_number}; offer to book the job. No pressure, no new prices.
actions.fallback_text: Hi {first_name}, just checking if you have any questions about quotation {quote_number} from {business}?

actions.text: Quotation {quote_number} has had no answer for 2 days. The AI assistant followed up.

automations.name: Thank the customer after the job

actions.text: Hi {first_name}, thank you for choosing {business} today. If anything is not right, just reply here.

automations.name: Rebook customers who missed their appointment

actions.instruction: The customer missed their {service} today. Kindly offer to book a new time.
actions.fallback_text: Hi {first_name}, we missed you today. Would you like to book a new time?

actions.text: {first_name} missed their {service}. The AI assistant offered a new time.

automations.name: Tell the owner about overdue invoices

actions.text: Invoice {invoice_number} is overdue. A reminder draft is ready for you to send.
